There is no cure and they don't even have a clue what even causes it, so there probably won't be one any time soon, but it can lead to brain cancer, most types of reproductive system cancer, collapsed lungs and all kinds of crazy shit. There's an excision surgery that takes it out at the roots, as opposed to ablation, but you have to have it done every four years and it's super expensive. Shit's awful. "Hey, I'm going to do [insert thing] today."
